# Baseline wish list quantities for food processors
cart_food_processors = food_processor_items  # from earlier
food_processor_ids = [it['product_id'] for it in cart_food_processors]
qty_by_id = {it['product_id']: it['quantity'] for it in cart_food_processors}

wish_before = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=amazon_token)
print('wish_before_num_items', len(wish_before))
wish_before_food = [it for it in wish_before if it.get('product_id') in qty_by_id]
print('wish_before_food', [(it['product_id'], it.get('product_name'), it.get('quantity')) for it in wish_before_food])
qty_before_by_id = {it['product_id']: it.get('quantity', 0) for it in wish_before_food}

# Move all food processors from cart to wish list (with quantities)
move_results = []
for pid, q in qty_by_id.items():
    res = apis.amazon.move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list(access_token=amazon_token, product_id=pid, quantity=q)
    move_results.append((pid, q, res))
print('move_results', move_results)

# Verification (single pass read)
cart_after = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
cart_after_food = [it for it in cart_after.get('cart_items', []) if 'food processor' in it.get('product_name','').lower()]
print('cart_after_num_items', len(cart_after.get('cart_items', [])))
print('cart_after_food', [(it['product_id'], it['product_name'], it['quantity']) for it in cart_after_food])

wish_after = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=amazon_token)
wish_after_food = [it for it in wish_after if it.get('product_id') in qty_by_id]
print('wish_after_food', [(it['product_id'], it.get('product_name'), it.get('quantity')) for it in wish_after_food])
qty_after_by_id = {it['product_id']: it.get('quantity', 0) for it in wish_after_food}

deltas = {pid: qty_after_by_id.get(pid, 0) - qty_before_by_id.get(pid, 0) for pid in qty_by_id}
print('qty_before_by_id', qty_before_by_id)
print('qty_after_by_id', qty_after_by_id)
print('deltas', deltas)

success = (len(cart_after_food) == 0) and all(deltas[pid] == qty_by_id[pid] for pid in qty_by_id)
print('verification_success', success)

# Complete task
if success:
    comp = apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
    print('complete_task', comp)
else:
    comp = apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='fail')
    print('complete_task', comp)
